name: V8 swap kit (Hana Roadster)
_note: Mounts, a crossmember and wiring to put the Brute 500's 5.0 L V8 in the Hana Roadster: absurd. It needs an uprated clutch (race), gearbox and radiator fitted first; then take the engine out and put the new one in. The V8 fills the little bay: there's no room for a supercharger or a turbo with it (and with one the roadster went three classes up: data/content/balance.json).
